qt: to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) Subject:

Fishing communities along Ireland’s southern and western coastlines face challenges arising from operating costs, access to fishing opportunities, regulatory requirements and the need to maintain sustainable fish stocks. 1.

How will the Commission assess the cumulative economic and social impacts of EU fisheries management measures on Irish fishing communities, particularly smaller ports and family-run fishing businesses?
What support can be made available to help the Irish fishing fleet improve energy efficiency, safety and environmental performance while remaining economically viable?

How will the Commission ensure that fisheries management decisions are informed by the best available scientific evidence while taking account of the livelihoods of coastal communities and the long-term sustainability of fish stocks?
